page.overview:
Who is Ancient Glass Princess?

Ancient Glass Princess ruled the Glass Kingdom centuries ago when Larvo attacked the Kingdom. She called for Princess Bubblegum to help her banish the dragon. However, PB struggled to contain Larvo, but the tide turned when PB's girlfriend Marceline started singing an angry song to her, at which point the dragon retreated.

Currently it is presumed that she has died, due to the passage of centuries and there is also no trace of her.

She is a pink crystal humanoid, with a bump on her head, a deep pink crystal gem on her bump. She has a bell-shaped crystal dress attached to her body, with various decorative details, some a deeper pink than others. She also has two other bumps on her head, hot pink with several little squares. She wore a necklace with a purple crystal key.
